subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament and State Legislatures to make laws for the whole or any part of the territory of India?
solution: The correct answer is __**Article 245**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Article 245** of the **Indian Constitution** empowers the **Parliament and State Legislatures** to make laws for the whole or any part of the territory of India. • It provides the **legal framework** for the distribution of legislative powers between the **Union** and the **States.** • Article 245(1) states that **Parliament may make laws for the whole or any part of the territory of India**, and the Legislature of a State may make laws for the whole or any part of the State. • Article 245(2) ensures that no law made by Parliament shall be deemed invalid on the ground that it would have extraterritorial operation, i.e., laws can apply beyond Indian territory if there is a connection with India. • The **territory of India** includes states, union territories, and any area acquired by the Government of India, ensuring the applicability of laws across all these regions.
